newsitem.title: POLAND: Zasada plans to sell subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Zasada plans to sell subsidiary.

text.p: Polish automotive group Sobieslaw Zasada SA plans to sell one of its biggest subsidiaries, car producer Fabryka Samochodow Specjalizowanych SHL SA, the spokesman of the company said on Monday.
"We are negotiating with a foreign partner to sell our stake in Fabryka Samochodow Specjalizowanych," Marcin Trzaska told Reuters. He declined to give more details.
Zasada has a 55.8 percent stake in the firm, which netted 40 million zlotys last year on 48.5-million-zloty sales. It employs 1,400 people.
Other shareholders are the state treasury, which has 30 percent, and steel mill Huta Sendzimira SA, which has 12 percent. The remaining shares are held by small shareholders.
Zasada has about 30 subsidiaries in its holding group.
